opening.argument: The pitch promises around $100 per day through an app, but makes investment a condition of earning and says the money stops when investment stops. That is the central appeal: easy income tied to continued payment. The speaker also describes users viewing ads as part of the app activity and says he forced users to use the app. Together, those statements present participation and user supply as the route to the claimed earnings, while pressuring users into the process. The record supports a manipulative, recruitment-dependent earning pitch; it does not establish that anyone actually earned the advertised amount or suffered a loss.
